name: mvp slice walk validates every hop against the frozen transition table and refuses an undeclared one, fail-closed (PHASE-56 W-1, R-17 — forced by F-2)
description: PHASE-56 W-1, ruling R-17. orchestration.advance_state performs NO transition validation (F-2/R-21: conversation_graph.validateTransition has no runtime caller and the 28-row table is documentation, not enforcement), so 'walk only declared rows' would otherwise be a discipline with nothing enforcing it. The slice walk therefore validates each hop itself before executing it and fails closed on rejection. Asserts: the production walk plan is OWNER_INTENT -> ARCHITECT_DESIGN -> SPEC_WRITER_FORMALIZE -> REVIEWER_SPEC -> COST_ESTIMATE -> ENV_REPORT and every consecutive pair is a DECLARED row; the plan stops at ENV_REPORT and never contains the owner-gated ENV_REPORT -> TEST_DESIGN hop (R-16); an undeclared hop (REVIEWER_CODE_AND_SECURITY -> TEST_DESIGN) is refused with a typed error and no partial execution; a hop out of a terminal state is refused; and the audit rows written by a real re-engagement contain exactly the declared hops in order, each typed VACUOUS_SKIP (already a sanctioned transition_type, so contract 12.2 is untouched).
